files.reason: Look for a mini-GMP lemma equating the value of the original little-endian limb list with the value of the retained prefix when every discarded high limb is zero. Check that the empty prefix represents zero.
Look for a normalization contract and loop invariant that preserve value when the used count decreases after a zero test. Check that the result is empty or has a nonzero highest limb.

Look for a little-endian append identity that expresses the full value as the prefix value plus the suffix value scaled by the radix to the prefix length. A zero suffix then gives the required equality.
